pairs.subject: declared-process-graph
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/scout/page.tsx:2 The scout 'graph' is a read-only lineage of records (seed, idea, storyboard, run, output) drawn in stage columns, not a document declaring long-lived processes on named channels; a search of app/(studio)/scout for spawn, child_process, composite, topology and descriptor found no hits, so no topology document is validated, expanded or changed live here.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/scout/_port/contract.ts:5 The screen takes a ScoutGraph the server already built and only draws it. No author-written document with per-kind fields gets parsed here.
app/(studio)/scout/_port/contract.ts:39 The only writes are pause/resume and split, which change the steer. No node or edge gets added to a running process topology.
app/(studio)/scout/_scout/bands.ts:85 The edges record what grew from what. They are not typed channels with a producer and a consumer, so there is no port compatibility to check.
app/(studio)/scout/_scout/bands.ts:179 The only numbers parsed are split percentages typed by the operator. They are not declared durations or sizes that reach a runtime conversion.
